mostWorthwhile.text: Combining traceable records with error recovery was most worthwhile: it distinguished checking how a finding was made from transmitting it reliably, without treating either as proof of truth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The local-autonomy sequence felt somewhat predictable: the final action largely restated the review boundary already given.

surprise.text: The record paired scholarly-looking fiction with observation histories to emphasize that evidence of how a finding was made matters more than an appearance of authority.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the connection between feedback and delayed contact was fairly broad rather than a detailed operational procedure.

continue.text: I would consider another chapter: the distinction between inspectable evidence, reliable transmission and truth was useful, although I would hope for less predictable choices.
